subject: Request for one-off POC credits and extension — Midfield AI
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@midfield.ai>, contracts@midfield.ai
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: 45-day POC extension + one-off credits

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for the thoughtful demo yesterday — team was excited by the latency and the prompt routing examples. Per our conversation, you asked for a short runway extension and additional credits so your ML team can complete the production-scale ingestion and edge-case test suite.

Quick summary of ask:
- Extend the current POC by 45 days (original expiry 2026-10-01)
- One-off credit equivalent to ~250k tokens (to cover heavy ingestion + reranking tests)

I’m pulling usage reports and will attach the dashboard with current token burn for context. Internally this exceeds our standard PLG free credit cap (we usually cap at 75k tokens for self-serve trials), so I’ll need an exec signoff.

Why we should approve:
- Midfield is a strong strategic fit (AI ops pipeline + potential first-year ARR > $1M based on forecasted model calls)
- They’re evaluating two vendors; extending runway reduces friction and increases chance to convert to Dedicated capacity
- The requested uplift is time-bound and measurable; we can attach acceptance criteria to the SOW (target inference throughput and latency checks)

I’ll escalate to Grace and Vivek for a quick decision. If approved, I’ll send an SOW addendum + DocuSign link.

Attachments: usage-dashboard.csv (staged token burn by day)

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@midfield.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@midfield.ai
Date: 2026-09-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 45-day POC extension + one-off credits

Alex —

Appreciate the quick follow. The team hit a larger-than-expected ingestion job this weekend which ate into the remaining runway; without more credits we’ll be blocked on the last two validation suites.

250k tokens sounds about right based on our estimate, though we can accept less if that’s easier to approve. Procurement needs a formal amendment for the extension and a short note on acceptance criteria (so they can justify to finance).

If you can get the credit and extension approved this week, we can commit to completing the tests and providing a results deck by the new deadline. Also fine with attaching a short conversion milestone (e.g., 90-day post-POC evaluation) if that helps.

—Ethan
Ethan Ross
Head of ML, Midfield AI
ethan.ross@midfield.ai
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: 45-day POC extension + one-off credits

Grace / Vivek —

Looping you in for an expedited deal desk approval. Thread below between Midfield and me. TL;DR: they need an extra runway and credits to finish heavy ingestion validation. Details:
- Account: Midfield AI (prospect, strong fit for Dedicated)
- Current ask: +45 days, ~250k one-off token credit
- Why: larger ingestion test consumed expected burn; they're evaluating us vs. Competitor X; risk of losing momentum if tests stall
- Potential: estimated ARR > $1M (conservative), expansion likely to Dedicated if POC meets perf targets

Constraints and suggested guardrails:
- Make credit one-off and non-recurring, expire if not used by extension end date
- Attach measurable acceptance criteria to the SOW addendum (latency < 200ms p95 on 1M calls, throughputs, accuracy baseline)
- Require procurement sign-off and a short commitment to a post-POC commercial discussion

Requested approval options (ranked):
1) Full concession: 250k tokens + 45-day extension (fast close, highest conversion probability)
2) Compromise: 200k tokens + 30-day extension + optional 10% trial discount on first month of paid usage
3) Minimal: 100k tokens + 14-day extension + encouraged targeted support session

I’ve attached the usage dashboard and a quick ROI note. Vivek — can you weigh in on whether finance/discount runway requires a formal Deal Desk ticket or if Grace can greenlight a one-off here?

If we can get a yes today or tomorrow I’ll prepare the SOW addendum and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Alex
Account Executive

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: 45-day POC extension + one-off credits

Alex / Vivek —

Thanks for the concise breakdown. I approve a conditional concession under option (2) from your list:
- One-off credit: 200,000 tokens
- Extension: 30 days from current POC end date
- Require SOW addendum with acceptance criteria and explicit non-recurring credit term
- Must get procurement sign-off and a short note from finance confirming no long-term billing impact (Vivek, can you confirm the finance check?)

Other conditions:
- This is a one-time exception tied to Midfield’s strategic fit and clear conversion signals; do not treat as precedent without Deal Desk review
- Legal to add a 30-day clause that credits expire and cannot be carried forward

Vivek — please escalate to Finance (cc me) for a quick confirmation. If Finance signs off, Alex please send the SOW addendum + DocuSign envelope and copy me on the outbound.

Grace O'Connor
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@midfield.ai>, contracts@midfield.ai
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: 200k one-off credit + 30-day POC extension (Midfield AI)

Ethan / Midfield procurement —

Good news: Redwood has approved a one-time concession to support your validation. Approved terms below (formalized in the attached SOW addendum and the DocuSign envelope):
- One-off credit: 200,000 tokens (non-recurring)
- POC extension: 30 days from current expiry (new expiry 2026-10-31)
- Acceptance criteria: completion of ingestion validation and delivery of results deck (we'll attach the checklist to the SOW)

Next steps:
1) I attached the SOW addendum (SOW-Midfield-v2.pdf) — please review.
2) DocuSign link to sign the addendum: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/sign?envelopeId=abc123
3) Once signed, finance will apply credits and I’ll confirm the new token balance.

If procurement needs any additional language (data residency / retention notes), let me know and I’ll route to legal for a quick addendum.

Thanks for moving quickly — excited to get you unblocked and across the finish line.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
Attachments: SOW-Midfield-v2.pdf, redwood-oneoff-credit-summary.xlsx
